method: Fixed asset, output-derived incremental lifecycle-factor accounting. Prior fixed-asset remainder carried forward; HVO WTW and proportional SCR N2O scaled, grid imports recalculated. No reinforcements, fuel transport geography, gas-side updates, OEM testing or standalone comprehensive LCIA.
unquantified: Embodied carbon of enlarged collector conductors, towers and transformers
Battery/engine degradation from new operating profile
Revised fuel production/delivery sourcing including ILUC
Protection, dynamic stability, grid connection and electricity-price impacts
Wind project siting and true observed production
Actual SCR N2O control and permit measurements
